'''Yenoa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] [[Sith Inquisitor]] of the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She was present in the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Imperial Citadel]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].
